mapper.select: select C.*, UC.achieve, UC.achieved_date from challenge C join user_challenge UC on C.challenge_idx = UC.challenge_idx where user_idx = #{user_idx} order by C.challenge_idx asc
mapper.insert: insert into user_challenge (user_idx, challenge_idx, achieve, achieved_date) select #{user_idx}, challenge_idx, 'N', null from challenge
mapper.select: select C.point_score, count(DISTINCT LU.liked_user_idx) likes, count(DISTINCT RC.reviewer_idx) reviews, count(DISTINCT M.match_idx) matches from coach C left join likes_user LU on C.user_idx = LU.liked_user_idx left join review_coach RC on C.user_idx = RC.reviewer_idx left join match M on (C.user_idx = M.user1_idx or user2_idx = C.user_idx) where C.user_idx = #{user_idx} group by C.point_score
